pattern.description: The full-size row of five app logos shrinks and drops below centre, converging inward, while a two-line headline rises into the freed space above it through a line mask.
pattern.why_premium: The logos are kept and re-laid out as a supporting row rather than cut away, so the headline inherits context from the previous beat; scale-down and text reveal share one move, keeping continuity without a transition.

build_hint.gsap: const tl = gsap.timeline(); tl.to('.logo-row', {scale: 0.45, y: 110, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power2.inOut'}) .fromTo('.headline .line', {yPercent: 100}, {yPercent: 0, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power3.out', stagger: 0.04}, '<0.1'); lines sit in overflow:hidden wrappers.
build_hint.remotion: const p = spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 140}}); logo row transform: scale(interpolate(p,[0,1],[1,0.45])) translateY(interpolate(p,[0,1],[0,110])); each headline line i: translateY(interpolate(spring({frame: frame - 3 - i*2, fps, config: {damping: 200}}),[0,1],[100,0]) + '%') inside overflow:hidden.

notes: Frame 259 shows the headline lines partly clipped, suggesting a per-line mask reveal; could also be a plain fade+slide. b01/b03/b05/b07/b09 are word/region fragments of the headline; b06/b08 are vacated old logo positions; b15 is an OCR fragment inside Sheets icon.
